title: Mom Calls Police On Her 13-Year-Old Son With Multiple Warrants
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 3rd, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a residence in reference to a 13 Year Old Child who had multiple warrants. It was said that the mom had called the police on him after he returned home after being missing for some days. The warrants were from a burglary incident that happened some months back. This is footage of the events that followed.
